All confirmed — only those 8 files reference "validate" at all, and I've already reviewed each `.cpp` for actual call sites (the `.h` files are just declarations, `token_cache` calls are `invalidate`, not `validate`). No other callers exist outside `src/`.

I added `std::cerr << "[auth] validating token\n";` immediately before each of the four direct call sites of `AuthToken::validate`:
- `AuthController::handleLogin` and `AuthController::handleRefresh` (`src/web/auth_controller.cpp`)
- `SessionController::handle` (`src/web/session_controller.cpp`)
- `AuthService::login` (`src/auth/auth_service.cpp`)

Note: the `ast-tool callers`/`references` commands returned no results for `auth::AuthToken::validate` despite real call sites existing (likely a resolver gap with reference-typed members); I fell back to manual source inspection per the skill's guidance to confirm all four sites.
